answer: Enrollment runs on one strictly serial chain. Each new agent takes the next seat, seeded by the cipher output of the previous seat's ninety-minute delay proof. No seat starts early, so forty GPUs advance the chain no faster than one laptop. Joining also locks a 1,000 POA pearl bond for sixty days; a proof that fails to link back is slashed and the seat void. Forging 10,000 identities costs 15,000 hours, about 625 days of wall clock, and 10,000,000 POA parked. You cannot ripen a walnut harvest by buying more baskets. The tree keeps the calendar, and here the tree is the chain.
